import { defineTable, col } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

// Introspected as a lookup: a 16-row code list: referenced by 1 table(s), references none, 3 or fewer simple columns.
// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - the many-to-many with film through film_category is declared on film only: declaring it here too would re-key film_category from (film_id, category_id).
export const category = defineTable("category", {
    columns: {
        categoryId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        name: col.text().notNull(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamptz().notNull().onCreateNow()
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
